author: Crypto Cronkite
title: The Week Ahead: August CPI release
dek: What is on the calendar for the week of September 7: scheduled events only, no predictions.
key_fact: Friday, September 11: August CPI release. The Bureau of Labor Statistics releases the Consumer Price Index for August 2026 at 8:30 a.m. Eastern, the last full inflation print before the September 15-16 FOMC meeting.
body: This is the week's known calendar: scheduled dates only, published in advance by the institutions involved. What happens at them is the week's news; this story only tells you when to watch.

Friday, September 11: August CPI release. The Bureau of Labor Statistics releases the Consumer Price Index for August 2026 at 8:30 a.m. Eastern, the last full inflation print before the September 15-16 FOMC meeting.
